messages:
jamie: Heads-up: console queries are trending out of control when we surface per-project attribution for proxied keys. Need a pragmatic sampling plan.
leah: Current telemetry tags incoming events with the raw API key from the header. That gives accurate key counts but hides impersonated identities.
mario: Right — any call going through our proxy looks like the proxy key. Customers complain they canan't see which project used the quota.
jamie: We must be explicit: enforcement and billing use the post-exchange authoritative counters. Telemetry sampling is purely for visibility/diagnostics.
sam: Proposed approach: hybrid reservoir sampler. Guarantee small N/day per distinct key (to cover low-volume users) and then probabilistic sampling for high-volume keys.
leah: Implementation detail: emit both origin_key_id and a compact eff_id_hash (e.g., first 8 hex chars of HMAC) for sampled events to avoid storing long strings.
mario: Also ensure each sampled event includes routing context: route_id, model_variant, region, and fallback_reason. Otherwise the sample is useless for SLO triage.
jamie: UX: don't add heavy new controls. Add a subtle badge on key & route pages: "sampled auth events: X/day" linking to a filtered log/explorer view.
sam: Add an opt-in toggle: "Include delegated identity in dashboard metrics (may increase cost)" default: off. If enabled we include eff_id details for those keys.
leah: Rollout plan idea: stage 0 = staging test with top 5k keys, retention 30d. stage 1 = widen to 20k and monitor cost delta and query latency.
mario: For cardinality we should cap the compact eff_id index to a fixed-size LRU: keep hot identities, evict cold ones. Document this clearly.
ops-bot: deploy started: telemetry-hybrid-sampler@staging -> v0.3.1 by ci/cd at 2026-03-22T21:12:09Z
jamie: Action items: leah build prototype sampler + eff_id hashing (PR by Thu), sam mock console badge + tooltip text, mario draft LRU index + rollout doc with expected cost impact, jamie to align w/ billing on retention & opt-in UX.
leah: One more safety: assert sampled pipeline is read-only for billing paths. Add an integration test that fails if sampled events are used for quota math.
sam: Tooltip copy suggestion: "Displayed metrics are sampled for cost reasons; billing uses authoritative counters from the auth resolver." Should reduce support noise.
mario: Agree. Also include a short FAQ blurb on why provenance can differ between console and invoices.
jamie: Thanks — set up a quick sync next week after the staging deploy to review numbers. :thumbsup:
